ScanScope: Candidate text files no larger than 16MiB: credential-like quoted literals and common token/private-key signatures. Values are never printed or serialized. This is a targeted scan, not a guarantee against all possible secrets.
FinalKeepRequirements: Use only KeepCandidate files matching their recorded SHA256 and byte count.
No Git history, old .git directory, missing sparse paths, excluded/deferred/blocked files, or screenshot binaries are to be copied.
Preserve deferred/blocked records locally and compare them explicitly later.
NPC and other concurrent task output may change; recheck hashes and update the manifest when needed.
The new Azure main would be an incomplete migration starting point, not a complete project checkout.
